abstract: Arrest of proliferation is one of the prerequisites for differentiation of cytotrophoblasts into syncytiotrophoblasts, and thus during differentiation telomerase activity, as well as human telomerase reverse transcriptase (hTERT) expression, is down-regulated. Considering this, it is of interest to investigate whether syncytium formation can be delayed by prolonging the expression of telomerase in cytotrophoblasts. BeWo cells were transfected with pLPC-hTERT retroviral vector and the reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction analysis for hTERT mRNA concentrations in the transfected cells revealed a several-fold increase in hTERT mRNA compared with the cells transfected with empty vector, and this confirmed that the transfection was successful. An increase in the proliferation, as assessed by bromodeoxyuridine incorporation assay, as well as an increase in mRNA and protein concentration of various cyclins and proliferating cell nuclear antigen, was noticed. The effect of hTERT transfection was also assessed after the addition of forskolin to induce differentiation and it was observed that cell-cell fusion was delayed and differentiation did not occur in hTERT-transfected cells. However, the effects seen were only transient as stable transfection was not possible and the cells were undergoing apoptosis after 72 h, which suggested that apart from hTERT other factors might be important for immortalization of BeWo cells.
abstract_ja: 細胞増殖の停止は、細胞性栄養膜細胞の合胞体栄養膜細胞への分化の前提条件であり、この分化の間はテロメラーゼ活性とヒトテロメラーゼ逆転写酵素（hTERT）の発現が低下する。このことを踏まえ、細胞性栄養膜細胞におけるテロメラーゼ発現を延長することで合胞体形成を遅らせられるかを検討した。BeWo細胞をpLPC-hTERTレトロウイルスベクターで導入し、導入細胞におけるhTERT mRNAが空ベクター導入細胞に比べ数倍増加したことを逆転写PCRで確認した。BrdU取り込みアッセイによる増殖の増加、各種サイクリンおよび増殖細胞核抗原（PCNA）のmRNAとタンパク質の増加も認められた。フォルスコリンを加えて分化を誘導すると、hTERT導入細胞では細胞間融合が遅延し、分化が起こらなかった。しかし、安定導入が得られなかったため効果は一過性であり、72時間後には細胞がアポトーシスを起こした。このことから、BeWo細胞の不死化には、hTERT以外の因子も重要である可能性が示唆された。
